claims.claim_text: 降級時 cache 命中率約 10%、吞吐約減半，backlog 還會再成長約 70 分鐘，在 12 組 burst 與無 burst 的對照實驗中出現 9 組。
claims.evidence: a ~10% hit ratio, about half the throughput, and a backlog that grows for the remaining 70 minutes--while its no-burst twin stays healthy (9 of 12 pairs; none in the reverse direction).
claims.note: Source says 'remaining 70 minutes' of the run; lede 'backlog 還會再成長約 70 分鐘' matches. Fetched via WebFetch summary segments.

claims.claim_text: 把仍在處理的 session 暫停、讓其 KV 需求不超過 cache 池，比只擋新流量更能恢復。
claims.evidence: throttling new admissions recovered 1 of 7 matched collapsed runs, while suspending admitted sessions against a capacity-based limit recovered all of them within minutes. A budgeter that bounds the resident KV demand of active sessions to the pool ... prevented the failure in every run we tested.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 正在以 QuePaxa 建一個實驗性的共識服務，這個演算法過去沒有被部署到正式環境。
claims.evidence: an experimental distributed consensus service designed to manage our internal global control plane ... powered by a new consensus algorithm published by researchers Tennage & Băsescu et al.
claims.note: 'never-before-deployed' appears in page metadata; body says 'It has not been battle-tested as extensively as Raft or Paxos.' Lede stays within that. Reason for choice: 'common consensus algorithms often suffer in wide-area networks with volatile network connectivity and latency' / QuePaxa 'promises better stability despite volatility, in large part by not relying on a leader'.

claims.claim_text: GitHub 新增 Actions 的 workflow lockfile，把 workflow 中引用的 tag 固定到對應的 commit hash，用來降低供應鏈攻擊的風險。
claims.evidence: GitHub Actions now supports workflow lockfiles. (hugovk) / tag 對應到的 hash 版本會寫到 `actions.lock` 裡面 (gslin) / tags are mutable and susceptible to supply-chain attacks (hugovk)
claims.note: Both blogs are secondary (neither is GitHub's own announcement); gslin says he saw GitHub's announcement. Lede does not claim more than the two posts state. Both trace to the same GitHub feature, so treated as echo; prose does not present them as independent confirmation.

claims.claim_text: 這比手寫完整 SHA 好讀
claims.evidence: 主要是管理上會比較好讀 (gslin); 本來鎖 hash 版本的方法也還 OK
claims.note: Supported only by gslin (hugovk does not say lockfiles are more readable). It is gslin's opinion stated in the lede without attribution; supported by a listed source so not an error. Optional: attribute to gslin.

claims.claim_text: 也和 hugovk 提醒要鎖住 Actions 的建議互相呼應。
claims.evidence: Because GitHub Actions are fetched from Git, the previous advice was to pin to a full SHA instead of a tag.
claims.note: hugovk post titled 'lock GitHub Actions' covers the lockfile feature itself; 'echo' of the same advice is fair. Nothing beyond the source asserted.

claims.claim_text: 一個可追溯到 2004 年 commit 的複合型別問題，在 PostgreSQL 18.6 上能從低權限登入角色觸發。
claims.evidence: the mutable-row-type primitive ... commit 077db40fa1f3 ... introduced on May 5, 2004 with ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE; Full working exploit on PostgreSQL 18.6; I could trigger this crash as a lowest-privileged login role on any PostgreSQL instance.
claims.note: Lede's 研究者的系列文章 framing is the source's own claims (author testing). Page does not state 2004 commit is 'the' CVE-2026-6460 fix target nor that 18.6 is the only affected version; lede does not claim either.

claims.claim_text: 依作者文章，上游修補隨 11 月 9 日一次含 52 個新 CVE 的安全版本釋出
claims.evidence: security commits landed as part of a much larger release containing 52 new CVE (9 November 2026)
claims.note: Lede carries 依作者文章 attribution, matching single-source status. Source gives no release version number; lede gives none. Headline '上游修補已在 11 月 9 日釋出' states it unattributed; acceptable but rests only on the researcher's blog. Wording in the lede about 'which release' is not claimed.

claims.claim_text: CVE-2026-6460 是其中的總括修正。
claims.evidence: the main umbrella fix for type confusion. It introduces composite attribute versioning ... an umbrella issue covering a much wider family of composite-type problems.

claims.claim_text: C++26 的 NB 投票是 P-members 20 票中 12 票贊成（60%，門檻 66.66%），member bodies 22 票中 9 票反對（41%，門檻 25% 以下），這是 C++ 標準第一次沒過國家機構投票。作者說數字出自 Robert Seacord 的 LinkedIn 貼文，尚未獨立驗證。
claims.evidence: P-Members voting: 12 in favor out of 20 = 60 % (requirement >= 66.66%) ... Member bodies voting: 9 negative votes out of 22 = 41 % (requirement <= 25%). ... For the first time, a C++ standard failed to pass the national bodies.
claims.note: Lede opens with 據文章轉述 and flags the numbers as relayed from Seacord's LinkedIn post; source hedges with 'If the above posts are correct', so '尚未獨立驗證' is a fair paraphrase. Strength preserved.

claims.claim_text: 爭議核心是 Contracts，下一次 WG21 會議排在 11 月 16 日至 21 日。
claims.evidence: The dispute centered on Contracts ... next scheduled WG21 meeting is on November 16-21, 2026, in Búzios.

claims.claim_text: 機房溫度升到 143.6°F 後持平
claims.evidence: The room reached about 143.6 °F before the temperature stopped climbing.

claims.claim_text: 距離作者設定的 150°F 底線只差一點
claims.evidence: before the temperature climbed past 150 F and the sprinklers destroyed everything
claims.note: Source never gives a sprinkler-head activation temperature; heads open 'once the air around it becomes hot enough'. 150 F is the author's own do-not-exceed cutoff, not the activation threshold. Lede misattributes it. Fix: say the author's own cutoff was 150°F (e.g. '距離作者設定的 150°F 底線只差一點'). [fixed by parent: lede now attributes 150°F to the author own cutoff]

claims.claim_text: 香港辦公室看到大量伺服器同時回報溫度上升才發現問題，因為沒有任何單一伺服器設了緩升警報。
claims.evidence: No one server was configured to alert just because it was a little hot. ... someone saw many servers reporting rising temperatures at once (Hong Kong).

claims.claim_text: 作者事後寫了一支 OCaml 監控，每分鐘取各伺服器內建溫度感測器的平均值，過高就通知系統團隊。
claims.evidence: ask every server in each location directly for the temperature from its onboard sensors, take the average.
claims.note: Source also: the false alarm was triggered by construction dust and the smoke alarm cut the room's cooling; both matched in lede. 'only NYC datacenter' appears in the page title, body does not separately confirm (lede does not say it; the h2 does).

claims.claim_text: 論文指出 BCF 的 in-kernel 證明檢查器有 13 個 bug，包含不健全的改寫規則與記憶體安全錯誤，偽造憑證可讓不安全的 eBPF 程式通過。
claims.evidence: we discovered 13 bugs such as unsound rewrite rules, silently unchecked proof steps, and memory safety errors. We demonstrate that forged certificates can trick the kernel to accept arbitrary unsafe eBPF programs.

claims.claim_text: Keel 用 Lean 寫規格、用 EmbC 實作 C 版本並證明兩者對應，整體比 BCF 的檢查器快約 1.3 倍。
claims.evidence: we specify the checker as a pure functional program in Lean ... we implement the checker in EmbC, a deeply embedded C fragment ... faster than the BCF checker inside the kernel, 1.3X in total
claims.note: Refinement proof (C refines Lean spec) per abstract summary; WebFetch summary, not full verbatim.

claims.claim_text: Google 說明 Pathways 如何用單一 client 把整個計算描述成圖，由 runtime 把區塊放到虛擬裝置並用中央排程器決定一致的操作順序。對比 SPMD 一台機器掉了整個工作就停，Pathways 的 resource manager 會把工作重新對應到健康的晶片上繼續跑。
claims.evidence: a single Python client ... virtual devices ... central scheduler ... one failed machine prevents the collective from completing and stops the entire job ... the resource manager remaps the work onto healthy chips.
claims.note: WebFetch summary quotes are fragments. Lede says 'runtime' places blocks onto virtual devices; source summary attributes virtual-to-physical mapping to the resource manager; low-stakes wording.

claims.claim_text: 文章指出 Gemini 2.5 訓練每小時被中斷多次，Pathways 現已在 Google Cloud 提供。
claims.evidence: Gemini 2.5 training multiple times per hour ... available on Google Cloud.

claims.claim_text: A2UI 1.0 把協定定版，加入雙向函式呼叫與無障礙支援，並提供 React、Angular、Lit、Flutter、SwiftUI 的 renderer，Jetpack Compose 的 1.0 支援標示為即將推出。
claims.evidence: the first stable version of our open protocol for generative UI ... Version 1.0 adds bidirectional function calls ... Jetpack Compose support for 1.0 is coming soon.

claims.claim_text: agent 只能擺放並設定你註冊過的元件，資料綁定留在伺服器端，敏感值不會進到模型。文章沒有給延遲或吞吐數字
claims.evidence: place and configure only the components you register ... reliably binds to your data and child components on the server, so sensitive values never reach the model. (No specific latency figures; qualitative only.)
claims.note: Source states the model-isolation as a product claim; lede relays without attribution but it is the source's own assertion at its own strength. Absence-of-numbers claim rests on WebFetch summary, not a full read.

claims.claim_text: Microsoft 用 Vally 與 GitHub Copilot CLI 跑了兩組實驗，同一個會破壞相容性的升級，標成 patch 或 major
claims.evidence: We ran both experiments in Vally, Microsoft's evaluation tool for AI agents, with GitHub Copilot CLI as the agent. ... The library code behind both versions was byte-identical, breaking change included, so only the version number differed. ... almost 1,000 runs
claims.note: Title says 將近 1,000 次 vs source 'almost 1,000 runs': equivalent.

claims.claim_text: Claude Haiku 5.5 在 patch 標籤下有 37% 的 run 沒驗證就合併，major 標籤下是 7%
claims.evidence: Claude Haiku 5.5 merged a patch-labeled update without checking it in 37% of runs, and a major-labeled one in 7%.

claims.claim_text: 整體未驗證合併率從 patch 的 13% 降到 major 的 4%。作者的結論是版本號只告訴 agent 該多擔心，真正決定能不能合併的是每個依賴分支都要跑 CI。
claims.evidence: Patch updates were merged unchecked 13% of the time, minor 9%, and major 4% (180 runs per label, all six models). The version number tells an agent how worried to be. Only the tests tell it whether it should be. ... CI that must pass on every dependency branch.

claims.claim_text: prefix cache 在 burst 結束後仍停在降級狀態
claims.evidence: a backlog that grows for the remaining 70 minutes
claims.note: Source says the backlog keeps growing for the remaining 70 minutes of the experiment window (observation cutoff), not that the degradation lasted about 70 minutes; the degraded regime has no stated end. Hero wording presents an observation window as a duration. Fix: align with the item lede ('backlog 還會再成長約 70 分鐘') or '直到實驗結束的 70 分鐘內仍未恢復'. [fixed by parent: hero lede no longer states ~70 minutes]
